deadline.value: Priority consideration by December 15; applications close January 15 (rolling review follows until January 31).

app_fee.value: The department states a $67 application fee for all applicants (the Graduate School fee plus processing).
app_fee.quote: An application fee of $67 is required from all applicants.

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Exams (GRE) are not required for our program.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require the GRE, so no Chemistry Subject test is asked for.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Exams (GRE) are not required for our program.

supervisor.value: The department typically admits PhD students only with a direct pairing to a research group, so name faculty you want to work with.
supervisor.quote: Our program typically admits students with a direct pairing to the research group they will work with.

funding.value: Doctoral students are usually supported by teaching or research assistantships with tuition waived and a living stipend.
funding.quote: Doctoral students in the Department of Chemistry are supported financially by graduate teaching or research assistantships, fellowships, or scholarships.

entry_route.value: Apply directly to the PhD; the master's is not a typical route into the PhD.
entry_route.quote: If a student is interested in earning a Ph.D. in Chemistry, they should apply directly to the Ph.D. program.
